basis: Developer source adjudication of the historical 19-target LUCI regression sample plus a fixed stratified first-by-page/id sample of 30 SOURCE_SUPPORTED proposals (6 entities, all 7 quantities, all 4 relations, first 13 statements). Not whole-document recall or independent expert gold. Duplicate supporting proposals are not independent scientific facts. Final-code replay retains all 19 target judgments; the rejected Objectives proposal is replaced by the next first-by-page/id supported statement, independently checked against the PMMA page-20 base-spread bullet. Historical 28/30 result remains preserved. Expanded retrospective LUCI development audit adds12 quantities spanning configuration, table-derived values, derivation, duration and oxygen extrema. Chosen from original source; model responses are exposed, so this is development coverage, not prospective independent acceptance. Incorrect pending proposals never count as accurately unresolved.
